name: Home's stacks stand another gap apart
find: .amb-stack { display: grid; gap: var(--amb-space-4); padding-inline: var(--amb-space-4); }

name: the body keeps a gutter of its own
find: .amb-stack { display: grid; gap: var(--amb-space-4); padding-inline: var(--amb-space-4); }
replace: body { padding: 16px; } .amb-stack { display: grid; gap: var(--amb-space-4); padding-inline: var(--amb-space-4); }

name: the door adds room beside itself
find: .amb-stack { display: grid; gap: var(--amb-space-4); padding-inline: var(--amb-space-4); }
replace: #gate { padding-left: 4px; padding-right: 4px; } .amb-stack { display: grid; gap: var(--amb-space-4); padding-inline: var(--amb-space-4); }

name: a list's rows keep a margin of their own
find: .amb-stack { display: grid; gap: var(--amb-space-4); padding-inline: var(--amb-space-4); }
replace: .amb-stack { display: grid; gap: var(--amb-space-4); padding-inline: var(--amb-space-4); } .amb-split .amb-row, .olist .amb-row { margin-bottom: 8px !important; }
